title: Forcing open the chained shelf revealed the founding ledger and scored points, but the log reads 'Quest failed: The Exile's Ledger' because Vell's secret came out involuntarily — a successful, in-character action is bookkept as a failure with no distinguishing flavor from an actual mistake.
where: The Hall of Ledgers, Marrowgate / 'snap the chain by main strength'
